report.markdown:
# Project Aurora Renewable Microgrid Overview

## Introduction

Project Aurora is a renewable microgrid commissioned in the third quarter of 2025 to serve the community of Millbrook. Operated by Rivergate Energy Cooperative, it aims to provide clean and reliable electricity to approximately 1,800 homes.

## System Specifications

The microgrid includes a 3.0 MW solar photovoltaic (PV) array spread over 6 hectares. The system employs highly efficient inverters with a rated conversion efficiency of 98.2%. These inverters support seamless transition between grid-tied and islanded operations.

## Operational Modes

Project Aurora operates grid-tied under normal conditions, exporting surplus energy back to the grid to maximize renewable energy use. In the event of a grid fault or outage, the system can island within 20 milliseconds, supplying electricity to critical facilities to maintain uninterrupted service.

## Control and Management

A local controller dynamically manages the balance between generation, energy storage, and load demand in real time. This controller updates every second to maintain system stability and optimize energy flows.

## Project Status

As of the end of 2025, Project Aurora successfully completed its first full quarter of operation, demonstrating its capability to reliably serve the Millbrook community with clean energy.
